caption: The drawing depicts a painted sculpture bust of a woman with dark brown hair parted in the middle and styled in braids that fall over her shoulders. Her skin tone is a light brown with rosy red spots on the cheeks. She is adorned with yellow, elongated earrings. The woman wears an off-shoulder garment that is colored primarily in red, green, and blue hues. The red portion drapes over her shoulders and chest, and a blue garment or shawl is wrapped around her upper arms, with folds and shading to show texture. There is a gold and red trim along the neckline. At the base of the bust, near the bottom right, a circular decorative element with a gray and white starburst pattern is visible, resembling a medallion or brooch. The bust itself appears to rest on an indistinct pedestal or base, also painted in muted colors. The background is plain, off-white, and the bust is centered within a faintly bordered rectangle. The drawing is composed to focus attention on the figure with no additional objects present.
title: Figurehead
